patterns.note: Full-width, distinct sections with large, centered typographic statements as primary content, creating a strong vertical rhythm.
Extreme contrast in type scale, pairing oversized, bold sans-serif headings with small, understated body text and an elegant script font for emphasis.
Predominantly monochromatic palette of black, white, and shades of grey, creating a stark and high-contrast aesthetic across sections.
Sections of large, bold typography and full-bleed imagery are designed to reveal dynamically as the user scrolls down the page, creating a progressive narrative.
Sections are clearly delineated by dramatic background color shifts (from dark to light, or to full-bleed imagery) and large, centered typographic headlines that act as visual anchors.

technique_notes: Uses GSAP ScrollTrigger to orchestrate the sequential reveal of full-width content sections. As each section enters the viewport, its primary typographic elements and background imagery animate into place, often with a subtle fade or slide effect.
The navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport, maintaining access to primary links across all pages.
Full-bleed background images are used within sections, often with a dark overlay or high contrast text to ensure readability of overlaid typography.

design_tokens.type_scale: Dramatic type scale with oversized, bold sans-serif headings (up to ~8x body text) contrasted with small, understated body text and elegant script accents.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with the exception of a perfectly circular call-to-action button.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, especially in hero and section breaks, creating a sense of grandeur and focus on individual content blocks.

standout: The site's distinctive use of extreme typographic scale, pairing massive, bold sans-serif headlines with delicate script accents, creates a powerful and memorable visual hierarchy. This, combined with the stark monochromatic palette and scroll-triggered text reveals, gives the site a highly artistic and editorial feel, making the typography itself the primary visual element.
